title: North Burnaby BJJ

services.name: Kids BJJ
services.desc: Our kids BJJ program teaches children the basics of Brazilian jiu jitsu in a safe and supportive environment. Each class builds physical skills like balance, coordination, and body awareness alongside life skills like discipline, focus, and respect. We keep sessions structured but fun, with drilling, games, and supervised sparring. Kids learn how to move, defend themselves, and work with teammates, all without the intimidating atmosphere of some martial arts programs. No experience needed. Come try a class and see how they take to it. North Burnaby BJJ, 4543 Hastings Street, Burnaby, BC V5C2K3, Canada 6042994590

explain.meaning: Brazilian jiu-jitsu, a grappling martial art done mostly on the ground.
